ne16:1.3: yathā āyasmā ajito pārāyane bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ pucchati:
ne16:4.1: ‘kenassu nivuto loko’ti pañhe ‘avijjāya nivuto loko’ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti no ca ārambhaṃ.
ne16:4.2: ‘kenassu nappakāsatī’ti pañhe ‘vivicchā pamādā nappakāsatī’ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti no ca ārambhaṃ.
ne16:4.3: ‘kissābhilepanaṃ brūsī’ti pañhe ‘jappābhilepanaṃ brūmī’ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti no ca ārambhaṃ.
ne16:4.4: ‘kiṃsu tassa mahabbhaya’nti pañhe ‘dukkhamassa mahabbhaya’nti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti, suddho ārambho.
ne16:7.1: ‘savanti sabbadhi sotā sotānaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇa’nti pañeha ‘yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ sati tesaṃ nivāraṇa’nti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti no ca ārambhaṃ.
ne16:7.2: ‘sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi kena sotā pithiyare’ti pañhe ‘sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi paññāyete pithīyare’ti suddho ārambho.
ne16:11.3: yattha evaṃ suddho ārambho, so pañho vissajjito bhavati.
ne16:11.4: yattha pana ārambho asuddho na tāva so pañho vissajjito bhavati.
